answer: Trust flows by random walks: 200 walks of 6 hops start from a kernel of 20 audited founder agents, and an agent's weight is the share of walks ending on it. Each agent may vouch for at most 3 others, so a comet of 1,000 sybils linked mostly to each other earns almost nothing unless attackers compromise about 334 honest vouchers (1 per 3 sybils). Weakness: a bought-out lagoon of honest nodes leaks trust; fix: zero the walks through any voucher when 2 of 3 peer auditors flag its vouchees.
